# Elsewindow

Canonical documentation: https://kogeler.github.io/elsewindow/
Source: https://github.com/kogeler/elsewindow

Elsewindow runs one remote Linux GUI application through Xpra over one owned
OpenSSH ControlMaster. It supports CPython 3.13 and 3.14 on Linux.
